chunks: From him, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him about the urine of the cat, the dog, the donkey, and the horse. He said: “Like the urine of the human being.”

key_terms.بَوْلِ: urine; the substance whose legal status is being asked about
key_terms.كَأَبْوَالِ: like the urines of; indicating comparison in legal status

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the urine of a cat, dog, donkey, and horse in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the urine of certain animals by comparing it to human urine. It appears in the context of purification rulings concerning bodily and clothing impurities in Tahdhib al-Ahkam.
